title: Spaghetti And Meatballs!
description: This mod adds spaghetti and meatballs!
body:
This mod adds spaghetti and meatballs!

## How to get/use each item:

**Spaghetti:**

Craft 2 wheat with one on top to get uncooked spaghetti. Cook it in a furnace to get cooked spaghetti and craft it with a plate to eat it.

**Meatballs:**

Craft 4 raw meatballs with 1 piece of raw beef. You can also craft it back. Cook it in a furnace so you can eat it.

**Plate:**

Craft a wet plate with 5 clay balls in a + shape. Smelt it in a furnace or blast furnace to get a plate that you can put food on.

**Spaghetti on a plate:**

Craft it with 1 spaghetti and 1 plate.

**Spaghetti and meatballs on a plate:**

Craft it with 1 spaghetti, 1 meatball, and 1 plate or 1 spaghetti on a plate and 1 meatball.


Credit to my dad for designing some of the textures!
